description.en: A short-shoot system bears grouped elongated follicles and attached leaf-petiole evidence.
description.zh: 短枝系统带成组长蓇葖果及相连叶柄证据。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Joffrea speirsiae, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Joffrea speirsiae 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Elongated opening follicles on differentiated short shoots differ from Nordenskioldia's radial segmented fruits.
distinctness.zh: 分化短枝上的长形开裂蓇葖区别于Nordenskioldia放射分段果。

modeling_brief.en: Model a compact long/short-shoot junction with several follicle forms; use one documented maturity state.
modeling_brief.zh: 制作紧凑长短枝交界及数枚蓇葖，采用一种已记录成熟状态。

uncertainty: One organismal concept covers its known leaves, seeds and seedlings; they are not additional entries.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. The later Munce's Hill paper uses Joffrea speirsiae; the 1985 description uses Joffrea speirsii. These are alternate spellings for this single concept, not separate taxa.

sources.title: Growth and reproductive biology of Joffrea speirsii
sources.supports: Paleocene Joffrea shoots, leaves and reproductive structures.

sources.title: Paleobotany and Palynology of the Munce's Hill fossil locality
sources.supports: Paleocene Onoclea fertile and sterile fronds documented together; later usage of Joffrea speirsiae for the Joffrea concept.
